priorityList: Summon your pet and use any long-duration stat-enhancing trinkets before combat begins.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath has less than 1.5 seconds remaining on its cooldown to maximize the cooldown reduction from the Wild Instincts talent.
Activate offensive trinkets, racial abilities, and potions specifically during the Bestial Wrath window.
Prioritize Kill Command as your primary attack, especially when the Pack Leader's Nature's Ally buff is active or Howl is ready.
Use Barbed Shot to maintain 3 stacks of Frenzy on your pet at all times.
Cast Barbed Shot if the ability is about to reach 2 full charges to prevent wasting cooldown time.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler only when Kill Command is on cooldown and you have enough Focus to avoid capping.
